text.en: Most dog owners praise the staff for their patient attitude, warm greetings, and accommodating customer service. Clients note that groomers take time to understand each dog's personality and listen carefully to styling preferences. Reviewers appreciate team members who comfort nervous rescue dogs during initial nail trims and bath appointments.

title.en: Skilled styling with isolated shave concern

text.en: The majority of clients express high satisfaction with breed-specific haircuts, praising tidy scissor work on small breeds and coat styling that holds up well. Owners love that dogs look fresh and neatly trimmed. However, one reviewer reported a skin injury following a tail shave, stressing the importance of clear aftercare guidance for matted coats.

Pet parents value the salon's low-stress environment and gentle approach toward pets with trauma or anxiety around grooming. Reviewers mention that dogs eager to avoid baths elsewhere happily enter this facility. Handlers use gradual introductions and calming techniques to ensure puppies and rescue dogs feel comfortable throughout their session.

q.en: Does Lucky Tail provide daycare alongside grooming?

a.en: Yes, clients utilize both dog grooming services and supervised daycare, noting that staff provide engaging activities.

q.en: How does the team handle anxious or traumatized rescue dogs?

a.en: The salon employs a fear-free approach with gentle handling, calm pacing, and reassuring techniques for sensitive pets.

q.en: Do owners receive video or photo updates during appointments?

a.en: Yes, several clients appreciate receiving video clips during grooming sessions that showcase how their dog is handled.

q.en: Can walk-ins be accommodated for routine nail trims?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note quick turnaround times for first-time puppy nail trims and minor maintenance appointments.
